title: Trump Announces 2024 Campaign
description_short: Donald Trump announced a 2024 presidential campaign at Mar-a-Lago on November 15, 2022.
description_medium: Donald Trump announced his 2024 presidential candidacy at Mar-a-Lago in Palm Beach, Florida, on November 15, 2022, one week after the midterm elections. Reuters described the launch as a bid to regain the presidency and get ahead of potential Republican rivals. Trump spoke for a little more than an hour to hundreds of supporters and critiqued President Joe Biden’s record.
description_long: On November 15, 2022, Donald Trump announced his candidacy for president in 2024 at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Palm Beach, Florida. Reuters reported that he made the announcement one week after the midterm elections, when Republicans had failed to win as many seats in Congress as they had hoped. The report characterized the launch as a bid to regain the presidency and get ahead of potential Republican rivals, with a possible rematch against President Joe Biden. Trump spoke for a little more than an hour to hundreds of supporters in a ballroom decorated with chandeliers and American flags. He told the phone-waving crowd, which included family members, donors and former staffers, that he was announcing his candidacy. Reuters reported that he critiqued Biden’s presidency and reviewed his own policy achievements. The report also describes proposals from the speech, including the death penalty for drug dealers and rehiring military members dismissed for refusing COVID-19 vaccinations.
